name: foundation
description: Gaia's context layer: the instruction-and-memory cascade that lets an agent understand a whole tree rather than the one file it was pointed at. Provides the whole-tree entry point that establishes, re-derives and sweeps that layer across an existing directory tree, plus single-scope context authoring, memory-store maintenance, registry reconciliation, repository-durability checks, session close-out, and the house rules for authoring new skills, agents and plans — together with the context, repo-durability and skills auditor agents and the remote MCP wiring that persists tasks, memory and evolution lessons across machines and sessions. Required by the engineering and product plugins.
